archetypes.name: dyn-oos-priority
archetypes.rationale: Priority OOS labeling spans filing, retry, and backlog reporting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed OOS priority-label paths in implement and design. Focus on whether high-risk focus-area signals are preserved through dedup, cap rollup, persisted sentinel recovery, and label-only retry. Check that non-priority and security-routed OOS behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-design-retry
archetypes.rationale: Design Step 5b retry state crosses session and lifecycle boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design Step 5b label-only retry flow. Verify prepare routing, durable sidecar restore, repo-aware gh calls, pending marker lifecycle, and Step 5b completion gating prevent re-filing and prevent Step 5b.5 from advancing while labels are pending. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
